identity.author: m-a-p
identity.description_short: YuE2-3B is an open music generation model that creates complete songs from lyrics and style prompts, with frontier quality competitive with Suno v5/v6.

prompts.contract:
Style caption + tagged lyrics (YuE2-3B — full songs, vocals included):
- First the STYLE, one paragraph WITHOUT tags: comma-separated descriptors — the language sung, genre, instruments, vocal character (voice type, timbre), mood, melody and phrasing, intended tempo in BPM. Engine's own example: "English, warm piano pop, expressive female voice, acoustic piano, rounded bass and light drums, lyrical memorable melody, unhurried phrasing, 88 BPM".
- Then the LYRICS, each section on its own lines under its tag: [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro]... The sung words only — no implementation notes inside the lyrics.
- Never rewrite, translate or extend the user's lyrics: enrich the STYLE only, and keep their words, language and sections exactly.
- Without lyrics, the style alone (the model then improvises or plays instrumental).

description: YuE2-3B generates complete songs with vocals and accompaniment from text prompts (lyrics and style) or covers existing songs in new styles. It supports composing melodies and chords via editable scores, allowing users to bring their own ABC notation or use an agent for revisions. The model achieves state-of-the-art results on the WildSongBench benchmark, outperforming proprietary models like Suno v5 and v6.
name: YuE2-3B
